name: Suwannee County, FL
findings: Suwannee County has 93 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Suwannee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Suwannee County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
